text_blocks.snippet: An ESBL infection refers to an infection caused by bacteria that produce extended-spectrum beta-lactamases (ESBLs). These enzymes make the bacteria resistant to many common antibiotics, including certain cephalosporins and penicillins. ESBL-producing bacteria are most commonly found in the Enterobacterales group, particularly Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae.
